mapper.select: SELECT 'POST' AS resultType, p.post_id AS postId, p.board_id AS boardId, p.blog_id AS blogId, b.blog_name AS blogName, u.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS userNickname, u.email AS userEmail, p.title AS title, LEFT(p.content, 150) AS snippet FROM post p LEFT JOIN blog b ON p.blog_id = b.blog_id LEFT JOIN blog_user u ON p.writer_user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.title LIKE #{likeKeyword} OR p.content LIKE #{likeKeyword} ORDER BY p.post_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT 'BLOG' AS resultType, b.blog_id AS blogId, b.blog_name AS blogName, u.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS userNickname, u.email AS userEmail, b.blog_name AS title FROM blog b LEFT JOIN blog_user u ON b.owner_user_id = u.user_id WHERE b.blog_name LIKE #{likeKeyword} ORDER BY b.blog_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT 'FORBIDDEN' AS resultType, p.post_id AS postId, p.board_id AS boardId, p.blog_id AS blogId, b.blog_name AS blogName, u.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS userNickname, u.email AS userEmail, p.title AS title, p.content AS snippet, #{word} AS matchedWord FROM post p LEFT JOIN blog b ON p.blog_id = b.blog_id LEFT JOIN blog_user u ON p.writer_user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.title LIKE #{likeWord} OR p.content LIKE #{likeWord} ORDER BY p.post_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
